blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Scottie Thompson was glad that Barangay Ginebra’s refusal to be on the losing side of history translated into a signature comeback at the expense of San Miguel Beer in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals. The Gin Kings moved on to the semifinals to face the TNT Tropang 5G after rallying from a 13-point deficit in the third quarter with a stunning reversal that led to a 110-94 win on Tuesday at Ynares Center here. Ginebra prevented San Miguel from becoming only the fourth team in history to overcome a 0-2 deficit to win a best-of-five series. “There’s so much at […]...
